title: The Law of the Female Captive Taken as a Wife
description: Rules for how an Israelite man must treat a beautiful woman he takes as a captive in war: she shall shave her head and trim her nails, remove her captive's garments, and mourn for her father and mother for a full month before he may take her as his wife. He must not sell her or exploit her, because he has humiliated her.
